title: Your Ultimate Gaming Companion Is Online: Tencent's First AI Game Companion Agent Eciyuan Opens Closed Beta

content_html:
Tencent has officially launched the first beta test of "Eciyuan," its first dedicated AI game companion Agent. The product is aimed at PC players and focuses heavily on real-time companionship in gaming scenarios, marking Tencent's substantial move into the vertical field of game AI interaction and anthropomorphic companionship.

The core technical highlight of "Eciyuan" is its real-time perception of the game screen. The AI can read and understand the user's game screen information in real time and provide instant Q&A support for various questions players encounter while playing. In terms of its feature ecosystem, the product not only supports seamless companion chat with QQ on PC and mobile, but also plans a range of interactive features such as a desktop pet, one-click wallpaper changes, an AI mouthpiece, and voice changing.

At the current first beta stage, four AI characters with distinct personalities have been released in the first batch, with special adaptations for mainstream popular games such as VALORANT, League of Legends, and Counter-Strike.

As AI Agents accelerate their penetration into vertical scenarios, game companions and intelligent assistants are evolving from single text interactions to deep visual understanding and real-time multimodal interaction. Tencent's launch of "Eciyuan" not only explores a path for AI to land in vertical niche gaming scenarios, but also provides a new direction for innovation in future human-computer game interaction experiences.

Website: https://eciyuan.qq.com/
